items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:60:1
items.html: And that one is complete Hochma of BON: Meaning true Hochma of BON, for it is the ZAT of the Hochma of BON, that is, the second point of the GAR of Nekudim, which is true Hochma. But the MA is nothing but the Hochma of the Bina of MA, and not true Hochma. And one must not interpret it as being complete Hochma in the GAR, for Atik took the GAR, as is known, and there remained for AVI nothing but the ZAT of Hochma and Bina.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:60:2
items.html: Both of them are called Aba, or Hochma, alone, since she is not revealed at all: As written above, that there is nothing more in the female than what she takes from the male; and since there is in the male nothing but the level of Bina, it follows that the discernment of Hochma that is in the female is not revealed at all, but only from the level of Bina alone, as above. See there.
